mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_service_rate ( user_id, service_id, rate, start_date, end_date ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{serviceId}, #{rate}, #{startDate}, #{endDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT seq, user_id AS userId, service_id AS serviceId, rate, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate, reg_date AS regDate FROM user_service_rate WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND service_id = #{serviceId} AND start_date <= #{today} AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{today}) ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1
